title: Weekly Reset
concept: A scheduled check-in — appreciation, checking the load is fair, one friction point, requests, next steps. Not a trial.
whenToUse: Same day and time each week; also after travel, stress, or distance. Not for hashing out a fight — if either of you is overwhelmed, take a Pause + Return first.
steps: Appreciation (5 min) — one specific thing each.
Check the load (10–15 min) — do you feel supported? Alone? Is it fair?
One friction point (10–15 min) — one small thing each; keep it to a small step, not the whole fix.
Requests — one specific ask each, for next week.
Next steps — one thing to try, and when you'll check back in.

phrases.text: I felt supported when ___. Alone when ___.

working: A clean, timed Reset ends with one phone-free evening planned and a Sunday check-in. Things stay small.
notWorking: Opening with a hot midweek issue, no appreciation, no time limit. Maintenance turns into a trial. Save the big stuff for its own repair conversation.
activity: Put four weeks on the calendar. Run a 30-minute timer. Use the in-app Weekly Reset wizard.
